title: Generic residue extensions and finite generic fibres
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning it admits a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $f:X\to S$ be of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Assume every generic point of an irreducible component of $X$ maps to a generic point of a component of $S$ [def-weil-irreducible-components]. Then the following are equivalent: (i) for each such generic point $x$, $\kappa(x)/\kappa(f(x))$ is a finite field extension [def-weil-residue-field, def-pc-field-extension]; (ii) there is a dense open $V\subseteq S$ such that $f^{-1}(V)\to V$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Under either condition, for every generic point $s$ of $S$ the scheme fibre $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ is finite over $\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-affine-spectrum].

source.place: Expose II Proposition 1.1.7, printed p. 24; the finite generic-fibre consequence is restriction of the finite map in (ii).
